title: Agentic Computational Algebra
abstract: arXiv:2611.16073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We explore the use of AI agents for solving computational problems in algebra. For the problems we consider, the main challenge is not correctness but \emph{time}: general-purpose algorithms are guaranteed to provide correct solutions but can be prohibitively slow, while reformulations that exploit special structure often allow solving a problem much faster. We propose to use this setting to evaluate how effectively agents discover and exploit structure within and across tasks to reduce computational costs. More broadly, computational algebra supplies infinitely many problems with independently verifiable answers and systematically controllable structure and difficulty. To illustrate these possibilities, we use benchmark families of systems with controlled shared structure and evaluate agents in three settings: solving independent instances, solving online streams of related instances using persistent memory, and compiling a fast reusa

translated_abstract: 我们探索使用AI智能体来解决代数中的计算问题。对于我们所考虑的问题，主要挑战不在于正确性，而在于时间：通用算法虽然能保证给出正确的解，但可能慢得难以接受，而利用特殊结构的重新表述往往能够大幅加快问题的求解。我们提议利用这一场景来评估智能体在任务内部和跨任务之间发现并利用结构以降低计算成本的有效程度。更广泛地说，计算代数提供了无穷多个答案可独立验证、结构与难度可系统性控制的问题。为了展示这些可能性，我们使用具有受控共享结构的系统基准测试族，并在三种设置下评估智能体：求解独立实例、利用持久记忆求解相关实例的在线流，以及编译可快速复用的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出以计算代数问题作为评估AI智能体能力的基准——因为这类问题的关键挑战是求解速度而非正确性——借此评估智能体发现并利用问题结构以降低计算成本的成效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using computational algebra, where the key challenge is time rather than correctness, as a benchmark to evaluate how effectively AI agents discover and exploit structure within and across tasks to reduce computational costs.
